print("""
# Player Churn Prediction Model

## 1. Project Overview

**Problem:** Predict which players will churn (leave the game).

**Business Value:** 
- Identify at-risk players early
- Improve retention strategies
- Increase player lifetime value

**Success Metrics:**
- F1 Score: 0.93
- ROC-AUC: 0.84

## 2. Data

**Source:** Synthetic player data

**Features:**
| Feature | Type | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Level | Numeric | Player level (1-100) |
| Health | Numeric | Health points |
| Attack | Numeric | Attack power |
| Defense | Numeric | Defense rating |
| Gold | Numeric | Gold collected |
| Play_Time | Numeric | Hours played |

**Target:** Retention (0 = Churned, 1 = Retained)

## 3. Methodology

### Data Cleaning
- No missing values
- No duplicates
- Outliers capped at 99th percentile

### Feature Engineering
- Created interaction features
- Scaled numeric features
- Encoded categorical features

### Model Selection
- Tested: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM, KNN
- Selected: Random Forest
- Reason: Best F1 score (0.93)

### Hyperparameter Tuning
- Grid Search
- Best parameters:
  - n_estimators: 100
  - max_depth: 10
  - min_samples_split: 5

## 4. Results

### Performance Metrics
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Accuracy | 0.90 |
| Precision | 0.90 |
| Recall | 0.97 |
| F1 | 0.93 |
| ROC-AUC | 0.84 |

### Feature Importance
| Feature | Importance |
|---------|------------|
| Play_Time | 0.18 |
| Attack | 0.17 |
| Level | 0.16 |
| Defense | 0.15 |
| Health | 0.13 |

## 5. Deployment

**API Endpoints:**
- POST /predict: Make predictions
- GET /health: Health check
- GET /info: Model info

**Dependencies:**
- Python 3.9+
- Flask
- scikit-learn
- joblib

## 6. Limitations

- Synthetic data (not real player data)
- Limited features
- No temporal dynamics
- No seasonality

## 7. Future Work

- Collect real player data
- Add more features
- Include time series
- A/B test recommendations
""")

# Player Churn Prediction Model

## 1. Project Overview

**Problem:** Predict which players will churn (leave the game).

**Business Value:** 
- Identify at-risk players early
- Improve retention strategies
- Increase player lifetime value

**Success Metrics:**
- F1 Score: 0.93
- ROC-AUC: 0.84

## 2. Data

**Source:** Synthetic player data

**Features:**
| Feature | Type | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Level | Numeric | Player level (1-100) |
| Health | Numeric | Health points |
| Attack | Numeric | Attack power |
| Defense | Numeric | Defense rating |
| Gold | Numeric | Gold collected |
| Play_Time | Numeric | Hours played |

**Target:** Retention (0 = Churned, 1 = Retained)

## 3. Methodology

### Data Cleaning
- No missing values
- No duplicates
- Outliers capped at 99th percentile

### Feature Engineering
- Created interaction features
- Scaled numeric features
- Encoded categorical features

### Model Selection
- Tested: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM, KNN
- Selected: Random Forest
- Reason: Best F1 score (0.93)

### Hyperparameter Tuning
- Grid Search
- Best parameters:
  - n_estimators: 100
  - max_depth: 10
  - min_samples_split: 5

## 4. Results

### Performance Metrics
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Accuracy | 0.90 |
| Precision | 0.90 |
| Recall | 0.97 |
| F1 | 0.93 |

| Feature | Importance |

| Play_Time | 0.18 |
| Attack | 0.17 |
| Level | 0.16 |
| Defense | 0.15 |
| Health | 0.13 |

- Collect real player data
